senses.gloss: pr. n.Parasopha, Prosopha (Prosopa), supposed to be the name of a place near, or of a building in Tiberias.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65">Gen. R. s. 65</cite> the arms of Jacob were as thick <he>כתרין עמודין דיפרא סופא</he> (combine; Ar. <he>דפרוסופא</he>; ed. Koh. <he>דפרסופא</he>) as the two columns of P.; Yalk. ib. 115 <he>דפרספא</he>; (Tanḥ. Vayḥi 6 <he>כשני עמודים שבתיך דמוסין שבטבריא</he>).
